nodes.description: uint16 transfer tax rate in basis points (default 800) read during _transfer to compute tax.
uint16 burn rate percentage of transfer tax used to split burn vs liquidity, readable/settable by operator.
uint256 anti-whale max transaction threshold set by setFee, read in _transfer as upper bound.
uint16 rate in basis points used by maxTransferAmount to compute anti-whale limit.
address excluded from the _total maxTx check inside _transfer, set by setAllowance.
mapping controlling which addresses bypass the anti-whale amount check.
bool gate for triggering the automatic swap-and-liquify path inside _transfer.
uint256 minimum contract token balance required before swapAndLiquify executes.
IUniswapV2Router02 instance used for external swap and liquidity calls; replaceable by operator.
address of the token trading pair, compared against sender/recipient in _transfer.
bool reentrancy lock flag set by lockTheSwap and read by _transfer.
address of the privileged operator checked by onlyowner and excluded from swap triggering.
Overridden transfer that applies tax, burn, liquidity, anti-whale checks and may trigger swapAndLiquify.
Private function that swaps accumulated tokens for ETH and adds liquidity, guarded by lockTheSwap.
Private function approving the router and executing an external token-to-ETH swap.
Private function approving the router and calling addLiquidityETH with ETH value.
View function computing the anti-whale transfer cap from totalSupply and maxTransferAmountRate.
Operator-only minting function that calls _deliver and moves delegates.
Operator-only function writing _total, the anti-whale threshold, from an arbitrary percent.
Operator-only function writing _tAllowAddress, the address bypassing the maxTx check.
Operator-only function updating transferTaxRate up to MAXIMUM_TRANSFER_TAX_RATE.
Operator-only function replacing the swap router and pair used for external calls.
Public function using ecrecover and an expiry check (now <= expiry) to delegate votes by signature.
Operator-only function updating burnRate with a max of 100.
Operator-only function updating maxTransferAmountRate controlling anti-whale cap.
msg.sender, the caller address used for operator authorization checks and transfer origin.
block.timestamp, used as swap/liquidity deadlines and as now for signature expiry.
tx.origin, the original transaction sender; not used for authorization in this contract.
External call into uniSwapRouter (swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens / addLiquidityETH) occurring during transfer logic.
ecrecover call in delegateBySig deriving a signatory from caller-supplied v, r, s.
amount parameter of _transfer driving tax and transfer amount computations.
sender parameter of _transfer, the token holder being debited.
recipient parameter of _transfer, compared against BURN_ADDRESS and uniSwapPair.
Local variable taxAmount = amount.mul(transferTaxRate).div(10000).
Local variable burnAmount = taxAmount.mul(burnRate).div(100).
Local variable liquidityAmount = taxAmount.sub(burnAmount).
Local variable sendAmount = amount.sub(taxAmount).
percent parameter of setFee used to overwrite _total.
allowAddress parameter of setAllowance written into _tAllowAddress.
_transferTaxRate parameter of updateTransferTaxRate written into transferTaxRate.
Local variable contractTokenBalance in swapAndLiquify capped by maxTransferAmount.

edges.reason: setFee is guarded by onlyowner which compares _operator against the untrusted msg.sender.
setAllowance is guarded by onlyowner comparing _operator to msg.sender, allowing an operator-controlled bypass address.
deliver is restricted by onlyowner, authorizing minting based on msg.sender.
updateTransferTaxRate is restricted by the onlyowner modifier checking msg.sender against _operator.
updateuniSwapRouter is onlyowner guarded, letting msg.sender-derived operator replace the external router.
delegateBySig is publicly callable and derives the signatory from caller-supplied signature data.
The percent parameter flows into _total inside setFee.
setFee writes _total, the anti-whale threshold consumed by _transfer.
The allowAddress parameter is written into _tAllowAddress by setAllowance.
setAllowance updates the _tAllowAddress state variable.
The _transferTaxRate parameter flows into transferTaxRate in updateTransferTaxRate.
updateTransferTaxRate writes the transferTaxRate state variable.
The amount parameter feeds multiplication/division tax and subtraction computations in _transfer.
The sender parameter is debited and compared to _tAllowAddress inside _transfer.
The recipient parameter is compared against BURN_ADDRESS and uniSwapPair in _transfer.
taxAmount is derived through SafeMath mul/div on transfer amount and transferTaxRate.
burnAmount is derived through SafeMath mul/div of taxAmount and burnRate.
liquidityAmount is derived via sub and validated by a require equality check.
sendAmount is derived via sub and validated by a require equality check.
transferTaxRate is read to compute the tax inside _transfer.
burnRate is read to split tax into burn and liquidity portions in _transfer.
_total is used as the anti-whale threshold require(amount < _total) in _transfer.
_tAllowAddress is compared to sender to skip the maxTx check in _transfer.
_transfer invokes swapAndLiquify which performs external router calls before transfer state effects complete.
_inSwapAndLiquify guard is read in _transfer to avoid recursive swap triggering.
The lockTheSwap modifier sets _inSwapAndLiquify around the external calls.
swapAndLiquify calls swapTokensForEth which makes an external swap call.
swapTokensForEth calls uniSwapRouter.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens, an external call.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline, creating timestamp dependency.
swapAndLiquify calls addLiquidity after the external swap.
addLiquidity calls uniSwapRouter.addLiquidityETH with ETH value, an external call.
block.timestamp is passed as the liquidity deadline in addLiquidity.
uniSwapRouter is the target of the external swap and liquidity operations.
uniSwapPair is compared to sender/recipient and gates the swap trigger in _transfer.
updateuniSwapRouter overwrites uniSwapRouter with an operator-chosen address.
updateuniSwapRouter recomputes and stores uniSwapPair.
The signatory recovered by ecrecover is derived from data supplied by the caller (msg.sender).
delegateBySig checks now <= expiry, a timestamp dependency enforced by block.timestamp.
delegateBySig performs ecrecover to authorize delegation based on signature inputs.
maxTransferAmountRate is used by maxTransferAmount to derive the anti-whale cap.
The antiWhale modifier invokes maxTransferAmount to validate the transfer amount.
swapAndLiquifyEnabled gates whether _transfer triggers the swap-and-liquify routine.
minAmountToLiquify determines whether the liquify branch executes in swapAndLiquify.
contractTokenBalance is clamped by maxTransferAmount inside swapAndLiquify.
_operator is excluded from triggering the swap path in _transfer.
